evidence.observation: Monotone pressure rise through growth, 2.903→3.184 Torr (k=20→24), while Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm and T is at setpoint
MFC steady at 99.7-100.8 sccm, so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a flow-step/pump-down test: close Ar and watch whether pressure falls to base) would distinguish a seal leak (air ingress, O2 rise) from an exhaust blockage (pressure rise with no O2 change).
